purpose: Pre-registered full VisionTrack TRAIN supervised association study for VGGT+GMT. This protocol is independent of JEV and does not use the prior Omega-Corr row-replacement result as a training target.

dataset.name: VisionTrack
dataset.raw_gt_policy: read-only; preserve every original gt.txt; duplicate, conflict, invalid, unknown and mixed rows remain masked rather than repaired

scene_split.selection_note: The six validation scenes were fixed before any new model fitting: prior strict-development scenes 1,10,18,19 plus conflict-heavy football scene 14 and basketball scene 22. The remaining 18 scenes are fit. No scene is moved after inspecting scores.
scene_split.backbone_exposure: GMT checkpoint was trained on original TRAIN; this is not a backbone-unseen split
scene_split.test_selection: never used for fitting, checkpoint selection, threshold selection or early stopping

A.name: fit_train_validate
A.selection: minimum validation listwise loss, then fixed identity-safe gate; no TEST access

B.name: refit_all24
B.selection: stage A only; no additional tuning

C.name: official_test_once
C.scenes: official TEST only after legal protocol audit
C.if_gt_or_submission_protocol_unverified: NOT_EXECUTED; report the reason and retain no fabricated metric

B_frozen_omega_fusion.required_evidence: causal per-candidate VGGT evidence for all admitted TRAIN scenes

C_task_adapted_omega.trainable: rank8 LoRA adapter plus bounded residual head
C_task_adapted_omega.rank16_policy: run only if rank8 is pre-registered infeasible and resources are available; otherwise NOT_EXECUTED

D_matched_dino.trainable: same parameter-count residual/fusion head as B

supervision.objective: identity-aware listwise candidate ranking on actual causal GMT calls
supervision.hard_negatives: same-frame competing identities, same-camera shortcuts, recent wrong IDs and pure-but-incorrect candidates
supervision.positive_policy: preserve correct, repair wrong, and retain legal no-match decisions
supervision.candidate_history: original live tracker history, logits, solver, threshold and IDs are retained

gates.full24_coverage: all 24 scene manifests complete and immutable
gates.validation_net_gain: primary seed must have more known identity fixes than harms on validation and no safety-gate violation
gates.gmt_invariance: OFF prefix parity exact before GT labels enter any run
gates.integration: only after reliable geometry and positive net identity correction; otherwise GMT remains unchanged

test_policy.historical_test_exposure: audit and disclose; do not claim unseen benchmark generalization
